newsitem.title: JAPAN: S.Korea central bank chief sees won steady vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea central bank chief sees won steady vs dlr.

text.p: Governor of the Bank of Korea Lee Kyung-shick said on Wednesday he sees the won holding mostly steady against the dollar for the near term, while he expects the gap between market rates and the discount rate to decline.
Lee was speaking to bankers in Tokyo.
He added that the growth in gross domestic product was expected to be slightly higher than six percent in 1997 after an expected fall to less than seven percent growth this year.
He noted that market rates were above 10 percent and the official discount rate stands at five percent.
Lee said the central bank believes exchange rates should be left to the market, although he expressed concern about sharp fluctuations.
On the issue of financial liberalisation, he said: "It's not impossible that the pace of financial reforms will be speeded up."
